Initial release of Ultimate Box Score, an offline ultimate frisbee box score recorder.

- Record games with durable action history, undo, crash recovery, and in-point substitutions.
- Manage teams, event rosters, and reusable line presets.
- Track per-game statistics and completed-game career totals.
- Export JSON/CSV backups and restore exported data.
- Use English or Simplified Chinese on Android, iOS, Linux, and Windows.

## Downloads

All application assets below are built by GitHub Actions from the release commit,
after generated-source checks, static analysis, tests, and all four platform builds pass.

| Asset | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `ultimate-box-score-0.0.1-android.apk` | Universal Android APK built in release mode, using the project's current debug signing configuration. |
| `ultimate-box-score-0.0.1-ios-unsigned.zip` | Unsigned `Runner.app`; requires Apple signing and provisioning before installation. This is not an installable IPA. |
| `ultimate-box-score-0.0.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Linux x64 application bundle; extract the whole archive and run `ultimate_box_score`. Requires GTK 3 and a compatible Linux system. |
| `ultimate-box-score-0.0.1-windows-x64.zip` | Windows x64 application bundle; extract the whole archive and run `ultimate_box_score.exe`. Keep the bundled DLLs and data directory together. |
| `SHA256SUMS` | SHA-256 checksums for the four application downloads. |

Android signing keys are currently generated on the CI runner. Later APKs may
require uninstalling the previous build before installation; export your data
first. These builds are intended for early testing, not app-store distribution.

To verify downloads on Linux, put them and `SHA256SUMS` in the same directory and
run `sha256sum --check --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS`.
